verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The harness now obtains the emitted test-function list from the generator, cross-checks it against the clean Noir file, creates a separate variant with exactly one corrupted live assertion for each function, and requires every corresponding `nargo test` invocation to fail. The Rust tests additionally pin complete site coverage, live-assertion placement, per-function isolation, deterministic generation, and rejection of unknown names. The changes therefore establish the claimed per-test non-vacuity rather than allowing one functioning section to mask others.
